pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with crenulated, high-contrast edges. The spatial area of patches decreases from the shoulder towards the posterior, where they become more fragmented and stellate in appearance.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream negative space forming thin pathways. Junction nodes primarily feature tri-way and quad-way intersections with high topological connectivity across the lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A stiff, erect mane visible along the dorsal neck, characterized by a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.
